issues.reason: The instruction set's own worked example routes exactly this shape as a rule — 'A package that is fragile or heavy is flagged' becomes (Implication (And (Member $x package) ...) ...), and 'when a bearing seizes, the pump stalls' takes the whenever-rule route with an indefinite singular too — so Existential's witness line governs plain episodic clauses, not a relative-restricted conditional generic.

Quantifier-less conditional rules carry strength 1.0 in the instruction set's own examples ('Every time the bell rings, the dog barks' (STV 1.0 0.9); the fragile-package rule (STV 1.0 0.99)); the 0.9 band is for kind-habit generics ('birds fly'), so (STV 1.0 0.9) on a stipulative norm is licensed.

Real over-assertion: with (Member $y keeper_family) as a premise conjunct the rule fires whenever the marriage is outside SOME keeper family — a strictly weaker antecedent than 'marries outside a Keeper family' (outside keeper-family stock at all) — so it awards the station in cases the sentence does not cover.

gaps_confirmed: indefinite-singular generic carrying a restrictive relative clause and stating an institutional norm ('A N who Vs keeps the station'): Existential (witness) and Quantifiers (rule) both reach it and no boundary between them is stated
new_gaps: an indefinite NP inside a rule PREMISE whose intended reading is universal / kind-level ('outside a Keeper family' = outside any of them): binding it to a premise variable yields the existential scope, and the premise that would carry the real reading ('no keeper family') is exactly the negated-antecedent form the instruction set says is not yet supported
defect_summary: Compliant form: carry the restriction kind-level on the oblique — (Outside $e1 keeper_family) with the bare kind symbol (the non-specific / kind-level filler licence), the keeper_family genus atom unchanged — in place of the premise pair (Member $y keeper_family) (Outside $e1 $y); the stronger 'outside every keeper family' reading has no licensed premise form at all, which is the new gap above.
notes: Outside is a licensed preposition-named oblique, the suppressed noun-modifier genus on keeper_family is right, and the top-level typing of the definite sk_station_1 referenced from the conclusion is right; only the premise's quantifier scope fails.
